chunks: He said: Abu al-Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahbub, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Sa'id al-A'raj, that Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq (peace be upon them both) said:
Indeed, among the most firm bonds of faith is that you love for the sake of Allah, and hate for the sake of Allah, and give for the sake of Allah, and withhold for the sake of Allah, the Exalted.

key_terms.أوثق: Most firm, strongest, most reliable -- superlative form describing the degree of strength of these bonds
key_terms.تبغض في الله: To hate for the sake of Allah -- directing one's aversion based on divine criteria, not personal grudges
key_terms.تحب في الله: To love for the sake of Allah -- directing one's love and affection based on divine criteria
key_terms.تعطي في الله: To give for the sake of Allah -- spending and giving charitably motivated by seeking God's pleasure
key_terms.تمنع في الله: To withhold for the sake of Allah -- refusing to give in situations where giving would be contrary to divine law
key_terms.عرى الإيمان: The bonds (literally: handholds/loops) of faith -- referring to the essential connections that bind a person to true belief

ai.seo_question: What are the strongest bonds of faith according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) teaches that the strongest expressions of faith are directing one's love, hatred, generosity, and restraint entirely according to God's will. This hadith was transmitted through a reliable chain of scholars in Qum. The teaching emphasizes that true faith is not merely passive belief, but requires actively aligning all of one's emotional and material dealings with divine guidance.

en.mulla-asgharali-m-m-jaffer: 1. He said: Abul Hasan Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn al-Walid reported to me from his father, from Muhammad ibn al-Hasan al-Saffar, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Mahboob, from Malik ibn Atiyya, from Saeed al-A’araj, that: Abu Abdillah Ja’far ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq, peace be upon him said:
"Among the most firm bonds of faith is that you love for the sake of Allah, and hate for the sake of Allah. And you give away for the sake of Allah, and refuse to give for the sake of Allah."
